description: Search Remote OK or fetch jobs by tag, region, or direct URL. Public JSON API — no login, no proxy required.

containsKeyword.description: Extra substring filter applied to the job title, company name, and description (case-insensitive).
containsKeyword.title: Contains keyword

enrichDetails.description: Fetch each emitted job's page once to add the salary range, applicant location restrictions, valid-through date, employment type, industry, benefits, and work hours. Many listings publish salary only on the job page. Adds one HTTP request per emitted job.
enrichDetails.title: Enrich each job from its page

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records. Remote OK's feed returns ~100 latest jobs per tag; combining tags or no filter rarely exceeds 600.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxSalary.description: Drop jobs whose published min salary is above this value.
maxSalary.title: Max salary (USD)

minSalary.description: Drop jobs whose published max salary is below this value. Jobs without a published salary are dropped only when this filter is set.
minSalary.title: Min salary (USD)

enumTitles: Search jobs (keyword filter on latest feed)
mode.title: Mode

postedSinceDays.description: Only emit jobs posted within the last N days. Leave blank for no time filter.
postedSinceDays.title: Posted within last N days

region.description: Filter jobs by region. Remote OK encodes worldwide jobs with a `digital nomad` tag and otherwise hints region via the `location` field. `any` returns all jobs. Note: many Remote OK jobs have empty or US/India locations, so filtering by a specific region (e.g. `europe`) excludes jobs whose location text isn't recognized as that region — including many engineering roles with empty location text. For broader results, combine with `containsKeyword` or leave `region` empty.
region.title: Region

salaryOnly.description: Drop jobs that do not publish a salary range.
salaryOnly.title: Only jobs with published salary

searchQuery.description: Free-text query matched against job title, company name, description, and tags (mode=search). Case-insensitive substring match.
searchQuery.title: Search query

startUrls.description: Direct Remote OK job URLs, e.g. `https://remoteok.com/remote-jobs/remote-senior-backend-engineer-acme-12345`.
startUrls.title: Start URLs (mode=byUrls)

tag.description: Single Remote OK tag. Use lowercase, hyphen-separated values (e.g. `python`, `rust`, `nextjs`, `typescript`, `vue3`, `gatsby`, `terraform`, `data-science`, `customer-support`). Any of the 240+ tags from https://remoteok.com/sitemap-tags-1.xml is accepted. Common examples: ai, amazon, android, angular, api, aws, backend, blockchain, ceo, cloud, css, customer-support, data-science, design, designer, developer, devops, django, docker, engineer, engineering, finance, fintech, frontend, full-stack, full-time, gatsby, golang, graphql, growth, html, infosec, ios, java, javascript, junior, kubernetes, laravel, linux, manager, marketing, mobile, mongodb, nextjs, node, nodejs, nosql, php, postgres, product, python, qa, rails, react, redis, ruby, rust, saas, sales, scala, security, senior, seo, serverless, shopify, software, support, swift, technical, terraform, typescript, ui, ux, vue, vue3, web, web3, wordpress.
tag.title: Tag (mode=byTag)

tags.description: List of Remote OK tags. The actor fetches each tag separately and merges results (jobs matching ANY of the tags). Use lowercase, hyphen-separated values like `python`, `data-science`, `customer-support`.
tags.title: Tags (mode=byTags)
